finding: The first clean qualifying beta and RC receipts were recorded under supplemental_observations, so the ledger ignored them for active campaign counts.
resolution: Runs 33289129127 and 33289130323 are now retained in observations with their activated campaign classifications, and successor packet elapsed values are derived from each receipt's own started_at/ended_at timestamps; prior technical-preview and contaminated campaign records remain preserved and non-qualifying.
non_claims: Observation counts do not satisfy the 90-day beta, three-cycle, or 30-day RC duration gates.
This correction does not close recovery, scale, external reproduction, preservation, or release-authority gates.
